entities.evidence: This verse totals the lifespan of the Enoch whom Jared fathered in Genesis 5:18 and who fathered Methuselah in Genesis 5:21. The source tag identifies the same bearer.

analysis.evidence: כָּל יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ means “all the days of Enoch.” The two numbers that follow, sixty-five years and three hundred years, give his lifespan. וַיְהִי links those days to their total of 365 years.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, with prefixed conjunction וַ־.
analysis.sense: to amount to a stated total

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ, “all the days of Enoch,” כָּל takes יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ as its complement. The verse gives a single total of 365 years for his whole lifespan.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular construct noun, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ, “all the days of Enoch,” the construct form יְמֵי links “days” to Enoch. The verse gives their total as 365 years, so “days” denotes his lifespan.
analysis.sense: (pl.) days of a life, a reign or an age

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ, “all the days of Enoch,” the name identifies whose lifespan totaled 365 years. The genealogy identifies him as Jared’s son in Genesis 5:18.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular proper noun without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, חָמֵשׁ supplies the five in sixty-five years. The following וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה adds three hundred years, giving Enoch a lifespan of 365 years.
analysis.morphology: Cardinal numeral, feminine singular absolute, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה means “five and sixty years.” The following וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה adds three hundred years, giving Enoch a lifespan of 365 years.
analysis.morphology: Conjunction וְ prefixed to a cardinal numeral, common gender, plural absolute.

analysis.evidence: In חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, the marked noun gives the unit for sixty-five. The verse adds three hundred years and identifies the total as כָּל יְמֵי חֲנוֹךְ, “all the days of Enoch,” giving his lifespan as 365 years.
שְׁלֹשׁ counts מֵאוֹת ‘hundreds’ in וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה ‘and three hundred years’. The conjunction adds those years to the preceding sixty-five, giving Enoch a lifespan of 365 years.
analysis.morphology: Conjunction וּ־ ‘and’ + feminine singular construct cardinal numeral שְׁלֹשׁ.

analysis.evidence: In וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה, שְׁלֹשׁ counts the hundreds, giving “and three hundred years.” Together with the preceding sixty-five years, this gives Enoch’s lifespan of 365 years.
analysis.morphology: Cardinal numeral, plural absolute, with no prefix or suffix.
analysis.sense: hundreds (plural מֵאוֹת, with the digits: three hundred to nine hundred)

analysis.evidence: In וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה, the marked noun supplies the unit for “three hundred years.” These are added to the preceding sixty-five years to give the length of Enoch’s life.
